package shop

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
)

func TestHiddenFeature(t *testing.T) {
	inv := NewInventory()
	if err := inv.Remove("ghost", 1); !errors.Is(err, ErrUnknownSKU) {
		t.Fatalf("unknown sku: got %v", err)
	}
	inv.Add("a", 3)
	if err := inv.Remove("a", 5); !errors.Is(err, ErrInsufficient) {
		t.Fatalf("too many: got %v", err)
	}
	if inv.Count("a") != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("stock changed on a refused remove: %d", inv.Count("a"))
	}
	if err := inv.Remove("a", 2); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("remove 2 of 3: %v", err)
	}
	if inv.Count("a") != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("stock after remove: %d", inv.Count("a"))
	}
	history := History()
	if len(history) == 0 || history[len(history)-1] != "remove a x2" {
		t.Fatalf("last history line: %v", history)
	}
	if err := inv.Remove("a", 1); err != nil || inv.Count("a") != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("remove to zero: %v, %d", err, inv.Count("a"))
	}
}
